name: Ring of Mystic Might
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 8th; Slot ring; Price 20,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This bronze ring is formed into a motif of unending power like an ouroboros. When worn by a spellcaster, the ring provides a +1 bonus to caster level for the purpose of concentration, against spell resistance, caster level checks, and level dependent variables.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells limited wish, greater magic weapon; Cost 10,000 gp
